Our checkout has returned
500 errors since 9am.

sections.brief: Hook: writing is slow and loose. Frame 0 is the thumbnail: the hook line 'What if a model never wrote a word?' (h2, centered) is already fully readable at 0 (pre-roll its words-in). At cue:tokens it moves up and a chat-reply card (surface fill) appears below; amber (`write`) words arrive into it one at a time like generated tokens (e.g. 'Sure! The label is probably "bug", though it could also be…'; type-on or word chips, visibly one by one). At cue:parse a mono line `JSON.parse(reply)` appears under the card and fails: a small `bad` red mark/underline and the text dims. The shared ticket and form stay hidden (key s1 changes nothing). End with clear.

The decision model. The narration opens 'A decision model works differently' (~8.3 s, a calm beat: e.g. a small violet 'decision model' pill fades in at top center, local). The ticket (state) rises in on the left at cue:state; the form rises in on the right at cue:questions, its rows staggered ~0.1 s with the empty boxes drawn on (draw-on) — bars stay empty (clip 0) and percentages at 0. At cue:pass a single violet vertical scan line (local) sweeps once left→right across both cards (~1 s): it reads everything once. At cue:probs ALL three bars fill together (to clip 1, same start, no stagger, ~0.8 s, ease out: one pass, not one-by-one) while the percentages count-up with them to their key values (1 / 98 / 1). Ink fills, it never pops. Then hold: breathe on the two cards; highlight the 'bug' row's bar once. End exactly on key s2 (ticket and form visible, bars full, values set) and clear the locals.

Three kinds of question, built from the form. Start: ticket and form visible as in key s2. At ~18.8 ('There are three kinds of question') the ticket fades out and the form moves to the left third and shrinks (~0.62) to make room for two more cards. cue:choice: a 'choice' tag pill above the form, and the 'bug' row highlights (one label wins). cue:noul: a local 'noul' card in the center third: the question 'Has repro steps?' with one yes/no bar filling to about a quarter and the label 'p(true)' — a probability, not a yes. cue:score: a local 'score' card in the right third: a 3-level scale 'routine · soon · immediate' with a violet marker that slides and lands between 'soon' and 'immediate' (a weighted level, not a pick). cue:closed: a dashed `decide` outline draws around all three cards' answer areas, then a ghost amber option 'something else…' tries to slide into the form and is rejected (shake, then fade) — it can't answer outside your options. End: clear the locals and fade the form out before ~29.8 so key s3 holds (ticket and form opacity 0); after the form is invisible, return its scale/position to base with a quick `to` so no other prop jumps at the seam.

Who makes them: hosted → open → local. Three plain name cards in a row (company names as text only, no logos), each landing on its cue: cue:jev 'Jev' (sub: 'TypeSafe · hosted API · Sept 2026'); cue:clef 'Clef · Clef Flash' (sub: 'Cloudflare · open weights · Apache-2.0'); cue:ollama 'Ollama' (sub: 'your machine · /v1/systemone'). Arrows draw on between them (left→right). Under all three, one shared mono line fades in: 'state + questions → probabilities' to say they all speak the same request. Cards may pop (they're the models), labels ease. Keep it alive with breathe. End with clear.

Our use, the limits, the takeaway (last section). cue:judge: on the left a 16:9 'video frame' card (simple shapes inside suggesting a diagram frame — not a real screenshot); on the right a rubric form like the hero form, titled 'rubric', with four yes/no rows 'motion', 'readability', 'composition', 'narration sync' — their bars fill TOGETHER in one pass on 'single call' (~43 s); bars only, no numbers. Caption 'one call · every criterion'. cue:limit: two muted caveat lines appear, words-in, one after the other: 'no explanation' and 'hard reasoning → big model'. cue:end: everything clears and the end card lands: two lines, 'decide → decision model' in `decide` violet and 'write → language model' in `write` amber (words-in, ~0.4 s apart). All beats finish by ~52 s; the end card holds to the end (≥ 3 s end hold) with a gentle breathe.
